2 حصّنهُ , [inf. n. تَحْصِينٌ;] and ↓ احصنهُ ; He made it, or rendered it, inaccessible, or unapproachable, or difficult of access; (Msb, K;) he made it, or rendered it, unattainable, by reason of its height; (Msb;) he fortified it, or protected it against attack, so that one could not gain access to what was within it; (Mgh;) namely, a place. (Mgh, Msb.) حَصَّنْتُ القَرْيَةَ I built a wall around the town, or village. (S.) ―
-b2- For the former verb, see also 4. ＝
-A2- And see 5.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
